summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements: Footer is updated with share buttons and copyright (REQ-1), Caffeine references appear removed from footer and index.html (REQ-2 partially evidenced), Profile page is unified with wallet content (REQ-3), and Central Bank page is restored with public data (REQ-4). However, several specific acceptance criteria have gaps or cannot be fully verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Scan the entire frontend codebase and remove every occurrence of Caffeine branding, links, or references from all pages, components, and layout files — not just the footer.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows index.html and Footer.tsx are cleaned of Caffeine references, but there is no evidence of a systematic scan across all other pages and components. Only a subset of files are shown as modified, and no confirmation of a codebase-wide removal is present.

missing_requirements.requirement: No standalone wallet route (/wallet) exists or is linked in navigation.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows App.tsx routes and the Perfil.tsx unified page, but WalletPage.tsx is not shown as removed, and there is no explicit evidence the /wallet route has been deleted from routing. The file diff shows 0 removed files.

missing_requirements.requirement: Page displays recent transactions fetched from Carteira A canisters.
missing_requirements.reason: The BancoCentral.tsx diff (truncated) shows supply, XP, vesting, monster, and bonus data aggregated from player profiles, but no explicit transaction history section or hook for recent transactions is visible in the truncated content.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure all Leaflet OpenStreetMap map pages continue to display coin and monster marker positions in sync with the Carteira A canisters, using the same canister actor and hooks already in place.
missing_requirements.reason: MapPage.tsx is not included as a modified file. The frontend-file-summaries.txt references MapMode.tsx with SVG-based simulation rather than Leaflet with real canister data, casting doubt on whether the map remains synced with Carteira A canisters.

hallucinated_features.description: ProfilePage.tsx is imported alongside Perfil.tsx in App.tsx, suggesting a duplicate profile page module may exist.
hallucinated_features.reason: App.tsx imports both Perfil from ./pages/Perfil and ProfilePage from ./pages/ProfilePage, but REQ-3 explicitly requires a single unified profile page and no duplicate pages or routes.

hallucinated_features.description: MapMode.tsx uses SVG-based world projection with simulated coin and monster markers at tourist landmarks rather than real Leaflet OpenStreetMap with Carteira A canister data.
hallucinated_features.reason: The file summary for MapMode.tsx describes SVG-based world projection and markers at tourist landmarks, which appears to be a simulated hardcoded implementation rather than syncing with Carteira A canisters via existing hooks as required by REQ-5.

hallucinated_features.description: CanisterArchitecturePanel component is imported and used in BancoCentral.tsx.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-4 specifies displaying coin supply, circulating and locked tokens, vesting, XP totals, bonus distributions, monster counts, and recent transactions. A CanisterArchitecturePanel is not part of the specified requirements and represents an unrequested addition.
